verdict.rationale: Background cloud delegation is a fair axis for a coding agent, but every piece of Aider evidence describes it working locally on your own git repo, interactively or as a one-shot `--message` script run. None of it shows a hosted, isolated cloud environment for long-running background tasks. The community 'navigator-mode' autonomy add-on is a third-party PyPI package, not Aider's own capability, and it also runs locally.

support.subject: As a developer, I can delegate longer-running coding tasks to run in the background in an isolated cloud environment
